verdict.rationale: Shortcut's pricing page lists a Docs feature with collaborators and a Suggestion Mode for proposing changes, which shows shared, collaborative docs exist in the product. The homepage's 'idea to spec to PR' wording loosely suggests specs live alongside project work. Missing for 10: documentation of how docs are created and organized (folders/collections), explicit linking of docs to stories/epics, notes functionality, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
